scope: Same hardware/device in fresh headed Chrome profiles; modes interleaved and rotated. Public encodeBatch with changing token IDs, resident weights, complete fresh detached F32 readback. Excludes tokenizer/download/model/pipeline/session creation. Authored experimental kernels are not Ink compiler output. Strict split is a matched-host three-dispatch control. Native float is approximate; no semantic-quality gain or compiler proof claimed. Resident completion uses queue completion, not GPU timestamps.
